items.title: New MacSync Stealer Uses Signed macOS App to Evade Gatekeeper and Steal Data
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new variant of the MacSync malware targeting macOS users. Unlike previous versions that relied on complex ClickFix techniques, this iteration masquerades as a legitimately signed, notarised Apple application, thereby bypassing macOS Gatekeeper security and stealing sensitive data. items.title: Phishing Campaign Uses Maduro Arrest Story to Deliver Backdoor Malware
